messages:
Maya: Taking the evening oncall shift starting 18:00 PST. Planned push for route-svc at 19:30. Canary: 3 hosts, 15m soak. Hotfix: header parsing + cache TTL tweak.

Alex: which service? got it.

Maya: route-svc. header parsing fix touches session affinity. cache TTL reduced from 60s->30s.

Sam: paste smoke checks and rollback steps?

Maya: checklist:
- preflight run @19:10: `./deploy/ci/preflight.sh route-svc`
- canary: us-west-2, 3 instances, 15m soak
- watch: route_svc_errors_total, route_svc_latency_ms_bucket, p99 latency
- rollback triggers: sustained >2% 5m error rate or p99 regressed by >250ms

Luis: i'll watch canary 19:30-20:00. @Shilpa backup?

Shilpa: cover 19:45-20:15 if needed, otherwise standby for alerts.

Maya: feature flag `route-header-fix` (default OFF). Will enable only on canary hosts. Flag in internal console -> feature-flags.

Alex: where's flip command? I couldn't find the toggle last week.

Maya: console path above. Also we have `./deploy/ops/flip-flag.sh` for cli.

Sam: rollback commands, paste here.

Maya:
```
# flip flag off for canary
./deploy/ops/flip-flag.sh route-header-fix off --cluster us-west-2-canary
# scale canary down
kubectl -n prod scale deployment route-svc --replicas=0 --selector=canary=true
# redeploy stable if needed
./deploy/ops/redeploy.sh route-svc --tag stable
```

Maya: quick smoke endpoints:
- GET /health -> 200 {v:ok}
- GET /route/lookup?key=abc -> resolve <100ms
- metrics: route_svc_errors_total, route_svc_latency_ms_bucket

(oncall-bot): Reminder: deploy freeze 23:00-04:00 UTC tonight.

Maya: noted; rollout finishes well before freeze.

Luis: preflight ran 19:11 11 all checks passed except transient 500 on /route/lookup (retry succeeded). Logs:
```
19:11:02 check route-svc test 1 -> 200
19:11:07 check route-svc test 2 -> 500 (retry 200)
19:11:12 metrics ok
```

Maya: kicking canary at 19:30. Watchlist: @Luis (primary), @Shilpa (backup), @Alex (APIs), @Sam (infra)

Luis: canary started 19:30. initial p99 stable, errors 0.1%.

Maya: posting updates +5m and +15m.

Luis: +5m 19:35 p99 in baseline, errors unchanged.

Alex: no header mismatch logs yet.

Maya: +15m 19:45 canary healthy. starting staged ramp to 20%.

Sam: infra on standby for rollback until 20:30.

Maya: moving to 50% at 20:05.

Luis: 20:08 at 50% we saw downstream DB replica lag -> small spike timeouts, error rate 0.9%, p99 +40ms.

Maya: hold ramp. notifying DB-oncall. Throttling back to 20%.

Jin (DB-oncall): seeing replica lag spike, catching up ETA ~8min.

Maya: holding until 20:20 to re-evaluate.

Shilpa: if DB doesn't recover, plan rollback + postmortem.

Alex: temporarily lower alert threshold for route_svc_errors_total.

Maya: update 20:22 DB caught up at 20:18. Error-rate normalized. proceeding to 80% then 100% after observation.

Luis: 80% at 20:25 no anomalies.

Maya: full at 20:35. monitoring for 30m.

Sam: after Maya signs off, who's night contact?

Maya: i'm on until 22:30. Alex will take 22:30-02:30 for night coverage.

Alex: confirmed.

Maya: handoff notes:
- FF name: route-header-fix (flip per cluster)
- rollback commands in thread
- canary config: deploy/canary/route-svc.json
- contact chain: Luis -> Shilpa -> Alex

Shilpa: thanks, handover looks good.

Luis: all set from my side.

Maya: handing off to Alex at 22:30. :wave:
